purpose: Executable detail for the already frozen Phase A diagnostic-overhead criteria, recorded before measurement
order: Rotate the three variants by repetition to reduce order bias; each owns a fresh store and the same binary
operationPattern: Each 100 sequential operations: 0..4 allowed PATCH, 5 denied PATCH with index -1, 6 filtered collection RunQuery, 7..99 GET. Document index is operation modulo 200; updates preserve its index and payload and set revision to the operation index. Query requires index >= 0 and returns exactly 20 documents.
rules: Read/query requires resource.data.index >= 0; write requires request.resource.data.index >= 0. Owner bypass is used only for initial seed and final state verification, never measured traffic.
subscriber: One real Requests WebSocket consumes complete JSON events continuously; subscriber and driver memory excluded from native-process RSS
verification: Every expected status/result is asserted; compare canonical final document fields across all variants; preserve each latency and RSS sample, response counts, Requests delivery and all failed attempts
statistics: Report each repetition, pairwise ratios/deltas, medians and p99; every enabled repetition must satisfy the original p99/throughput/RSS bounds versus its paired disabled repetition. No sample exclusion or threshold relaxation.
scope: Short local diagnostic qualification, not consumer/endurance acceptance. Record hardware, OS, binary, driver and manifest hashes. RSS is not PSS; do not compare it to another process or an unmatched official run.
